newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters sees U.S. revenue/profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Wolters sees U.S. revenue/profit growth.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Monday it believed North America could be generating some 40 percent of its sales and profits within a few years.
"I think that in a few years we should be making 40 pct of our revenues and profits in America, if we do things well," executive board chairman Cor Brakel told reporters.

Wolters Kluwer boosted its North American sales and operating profit to around 30 percent of the group total last year from around 10 percent in 1995 by acquiring U.S. tax publisher CCH at the beginning of 1996.
